name: Spacetalk Limited
summary: Spacetalk Limited designs, develops, and commercializes smartphone + watch wearables devices for children, and software for school communication and student absence management in Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The company operates through School Messaging Services, Smart Watches and Apps, and Other segments. It offers Outreach+, a content management and messaging platform for mobile school communications; School Star, a school news and messaging app; and MessageYou, a student absence notification. The company also provides WatchLists, an absence analytics software; and RollMarker, a student attendance management solution. In addition, it supplies Spacetalk smartwatches and applications through retail distribution networks and online sales. The company was formerly known as MGM Wireless Limited and changed its name to Spacetalk Limited in November 2020. Spacetalk Limited is headquartered in Rose Park, Australia.
